name: luxenails-support-desk
description: LUXENAILS — AI Customer Support Desk for a premium nail salon

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:setup
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend && npm run prisma:push --prefix backend && npm run seed --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
